# Architecture
<!-- AUTO-GENERATED:BEGIN overview -->
Pure Lua 5.1 library (LuaJIT compatible, no dependencies). `src/ratelimit/bucket_util.lua` holds the token-bucket
helpers as a module table `M`; buckets are plain tables mutated in place. Tests: busted specs in `spec/`.
Types are LuaLS / EmmyLua annotations (`.luarc.json`); editors rely on them for completion and type checks.
